description: FULL-chain Q_β prediction per prop:beta-decay-energy-scale. E_0 derived from CAL-1 m_e + CAL-2 q_0 only (no CAL-3 input); Q_β predicted via |Δ(net)| · E_0; observable/virtual split by Coxeter length ℓ ≥ 2 (Hopf links + trefoil) vs ℓ < 2 (γ + σ_0 + σ_1). Owner directive 2026-05-10: do not use LO; use FULL.
calibration_inputs_NOT_used: CODATA m_p, m_n, m_4He, etc. — predictions, not inputs (per Workplan 0a discipline)

energy_scale_E_0.residual_attribution: 0.75% residual is the brane-tower correction: the derived expression uses single-level c_q² ℏ_q, while the calibrated value implicitly includes the full tower of n and p (per beta-decay-energy-scale.md §Calibration cross-check).

q_beta_prediction.Q_beta_pred_formula: Q_β = m_e · |q² - 2q - 1| · (q+1) / (2q³)  (single-wrap symbolic form per prop:neutron-qvalue-symbolic). The L_± and e^- contributions cancel exactly at single wrap; Q-value comes entirely from γ + σ_0 + σ_1 channels.
q_beta_prediction.residual_attribution: +0.17% / +1.31 keV is the brane-tower truncation residual: derived E_0 = m_e/(q(q-1)) is the single-level Planck-tick approximation; exact tower-summed E_0 absorbs this 0.17%. Closure path: Workplan 2 Phase 2 50-dps m_e_Hecke lift.

q_beta_typed_crossings_legacy.comment: Legacy 6-term decomposition that gave +0.747% error (the L_± and e^- channels picked up small asymmetric contributions that exactly cancel at single wrap). Replaced by the single-wrap symbolic form above (4.5x improvement). Kept here only for cross-check.

observable_virtual_split.Q_observable_formula: |Δ(obs)| · E_0  (ℓ ≥ 2 terms: Hopf links L_±, trefoil e^-)
observable_virtual_split.physical_interpretation: Observable component (58.46%) is the topologically non-trivial part — physical kinetic energy released in the β-decay event. Virtual component (41.54%) is the gauge / vacuum-debt contribution that cancels in asymptotic states. See beta-decay-energy-scale.md §'Observable vs virtual: Q_{≥2}'.
